title: A first Python workshop, ending in a chart

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Where do you start if you've never written Python, but you want to chart a stock? Workshop1 has a path.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's a set of Jupyter notebooks from the AlgoÉTS club, built so each new idea has somewhere to go: a request becomes a table, and the table becomes a chart.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Setup first, then Python basics, then calling a web API, then cleaning data with pandas, then visualization. Nine notebooks across six stages.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Apple's stock. The final project fetches daily prices, computes a twenty day moving average and plots it against the closing price. Another notebook adds a few more indicators.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So you finish with something you can actually look at.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. It's a good first contact for finance students, before moving on to a bigger batch experiment. The page links the notebooks, including a Colab copy.
